Class DeclareFirePowerState

All Implemented Interfaces:
AdventureStateInterface, GameStateInterface
public final class DeclareFirePowerState extends ActivateState implements GameStateInterface
Represents the state where players declare and activate firepower in the Galaxy Truckers game. This state allows players to activate cannon components on their ship to determine their combat strength. Only cannons that are in the activatable components map can be used.

This is a specific implementation of the ActivateState focused on cannon activation.

    • DeclareFirePowerState

      public DeclareFirePowerState(ShipBoard myShip, ShipBoard shipBoard)
      Creates a new DeclareFirePowerState for firepower declaration. Initializes the state with the player's ship and the currently active ship. The available positions for activation are determined by filtering the ship's cannons to include only those that are currently activatable.
      Parameters:
      myShip - The ship board of the local player
      shipBoard - The ship board that is currently active
